rows.text_en: Ministry of the Interior and Safety (Balanced Development System Division), 044-205-3504

rows.source_ko: 제1조(목적) 이 규칙은 「농어촌 도로정비법」 및 동법 시행령에서 위임된 사항과 그 시행에 관하여 필요한 사항을 규정함을 목적으로 한다. <개정 2005. 2. 25.>
rows.text_en: Article 1 (Purpose) The purpose of this Rule is to prescribe matters delegated by the Rural Road Maintenance Act and its Enforcement Decree, as well as matters necessary for the implementation thereof. <Amended Feb. 25, 2005>

rows.source_ko: 제2조(도로정비 허가신청등) ①「농어촌 도로정비법 시행령」(이하 “영”이라 한다) 제4조제1항의 규정에 의한 도로정비허가신청서는 별지 제1호서식과 같다. <개정 2005. 2. 25.>
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Application for Road Maintenance Permit, etc.) ① The application form for a road maintenance permit pursuant to Article 4, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree of the Rural Road Maintenance Act (hereinafter referred to as the “Decree”) shall be as specified in Form No. 1 of the Attached Form . <Amended Feb. 25, 2005>

rows.source_ko: ②영 제4조제4항의 규정에 의한 도로정비허가 내용의 공고는 별지 제2호서식에 의한다.
rows.text_en: ② The public notice of the contents of the road maintenance permit pursuant to the provisions of Article 4, Paragraph 4 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in accordance with Form No. 2 of the Attached Form .

rows.source_ko: ③영 제4조제5항의 규정에 의한 도로정비공사의 준공검사신청은 별지 제4호서식에 의한다. <개정 1999. 3. 25.>
rows.text_en: ③ An application for completion inspection of road maintenance work pursuant to the provisions of Article 4, Paragraph 5 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in accordance with Form No. 4 of the Attached Form . <Amended Mar. 25, 1999>
[Title amended Jan. 25, 1995]

rows.source_ko: 제3조(기본계획의 수립 및 절차등) ①군수(도농복합형태의 시의 시장, 특별자치시장 및 특별자치도지사를 포함한다. 이하 같다)는 「농어촌 도로정비법」(이하 “법”이라 한다) 제6조제1항에 따라 도로기본계획을 수립하는 때에는 다음 각 호의 사항을 포함하여야 한다. <개정 1995. 1. 25., 1999. 3. 25., 2005. 2. 25., 2017. 9. 21.>
rows.text_en: Article 3 (Establishment and Procedures, etc. of Basic Plan) ① When the County Governor (including the Mayor of a city with a mixed urban-rural form, the Mayor of a Special Self-Governing City, and the Governor of a Special Self-Governing Province; hereinafter the same applies) establishes a basic road plan pursuant to Article 6, Paragraph 1 of the Rural Road Maintenance Act (hereinafter referred to as the “Act”), the plan shall include the matters in each of the following subparagraphs. <Amended Jan. 25, 1995; Mar. 25, 1999; Feb. 25, 2005; Sep. 21, 2017>
1. Route Survey Form ( Attachment No. 5)

rows.source_ko: 2. 노선조사서에 따라 작성된 도로망종합도(축척 5만분의 1의 지형도에 면도는 붉은색, 리도는 청색, 농도는 노란색으로 각각 구분하여 표시하여야 한다)
rows.text_en: 2. Comprehensive road network map prepared according to the route survey report (on a topographic map with a scale of 1:50,000, township roads must be distinguished and indicated in red, village roads in blue, and agricultural roads in yellow, respectively)
3. Usage and Feasibility of Roads by Route

rows.source_ko: 4. 군도 이상의 도로 및 행정구역 경계지점 간의 도로연결망의 타당성
rows.text_en: 4. Feasibility of road network between county roads or higher and administrative district boundary points
② Deleted <February 25, 2005>
③ Deleted <September 21, 2017>

rows.source_ko: 제4조(도로기본계획의 고시) 법 제6조제3항 및 제5항의 규정에 의한 도로기본계획의 고시 및 변경고시는 별지 제6호서식에 의한다. <개정 2005. 2. 25., 2017. 9. 21.>
rows.text_en: Article 4 (Notice of Basic Road Plan) The notice of the Basic Road Plan and the notice of amendment pursuant to the provisions of Article 6 , Paragraphs 3 and 5 of the Act shall be in accordance with Form No. 6 of the Attached Form. <Amended Feb. 25, 2005; Sep. 21, 2017>

rows.source_ko: 제5조(도로정비계획의 수립 및 절차) 군수는 법 제7조제1항의 규정에 의한 도로정비계획을 수립한 때에는 도로정비계획서에 별지 제7호서식의 도로정비계획노선내역서를 작성하여야 한다. <개정 2017. 9. 21.>
rows.text_en: Article 5 (Establishment and Procedure of Road Maintenance Plan) When the County Head has established a road maintenance plan pursuant to the provisions of Article 7, Paragraph 1 of the Act , he/she shall prepare a detailed road maintenance plan route statement in the form of Annex 7 in the road maintenance plan document. <Amended Sep. 21, 2017>
[Wholly Amended Feb. 25, 2005]

rows.source_ko: 제6조(도로정비계획의 공고) 법 제7조제3항의 규정에 의한 도로정비계획의 공고는 별지 제8호서식에 의한다.
rows.text_en: Article 6 (Publication of Road Maintenance Plan) The public notice of a road maintenance plan pursuant to the provisions of Article 7, Paragraph 3 of the Act shall be in accordance with Form No. 8 of the Attached Form.

rows.source_ko: 제7조(도로사업계획의 수립 및 절차등) ①군수는 법 제8조제1항의 규정에 의하여 도로사업계획을 수립할 때에는 도로의 노선별로 다음 사항을 종합적으로 평가하고 그 평가결과에 따른 우선순위에 따라 사업대상이 되는 도로의 노선을 선정하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 7 (Establishment of Road Project Plan and Procedures, etc.) ① When the County Governor establishes a road project plan pursuant to the provisions of Article 8, Paragraph 1 of the Act , he/she shall comprehensively evaluate the following matters for each road route and select the road routes to be the subject of the project according to the priority order based on the evaluation results.
1. Residents' usage
2. Contribution to the increase in residents' income
3. Contribution to residents' transportation convenience
4. Contribution to the improvement of residents' living conditions
5. Connectivity with the road network

rows.source_ko: ②군수는 제1항의 규정에 의한 도로의 노선선정을 위한 도로의 노선별 기초자료조사 및 평가를 한국농어촌공사 등 관계전문기관에 의뢰하고 그 결과를 참작하여야 한다. <개정 2005. 2. 25., 2006. 4. 28., 2017. 9. 21.>
rows.text_en: ② The County Governor shall commission relevant specialized agencies, such as the Korea Rural Community Corporation, to conduct a survey of basic data and an evaluation of each road route for the selection of road routes pursuant to the provisions of Paragraph 1, and shall take the results into consideration. <Amended Feb. 25, 2005; Apr. 28, 2006; Sep. 21, 2017>

rows.source_ko: ③군수는 법 제8조제1항의 규정에 의한 도로사업계획을 수립하는 경우에는 도로사업계획서에 별지 제9호서식의 도로사업계획 노선내역서와 전문기관의 도로노선별 기초자료조사 및 평가서를 포함하여야 한다. <개정 1999. 3. 25., 2017. 9. 21.>
rows.text_en: ③ When the County Head formulates a road project plan pursuant to the provisions of Article 8, Paragraph 1 of the Act , he/she shall include the detailed road project route statement in Annex 9 and the basic data survey and evaluation report for each road route by a specialized agency in the road project plan. <Amended Mar. 25, 1999; Sep. 21, 2017>
④ Deleted <September 21, 2017>

rows.source_ko: 제8조(도로의 노선지정공고) 법 제9조제5항의 규정에 의한 도로사업계획이 확정된 도로의 노선의 지정공고 및 지정변경공고는 별지 제10호서식에 의한다.
rows.text_en: Article 8 (Public Notice of Designation of Road Route) The public notice of designation and the public notice of change of designation for a road route for which a road project plan has been finalized pursuant to the provisions of Article 9, Paragraph 5 of the Act shall be in accordance with Form No. 10 of the Attached Form .

rows.source_ko: 제9조(타공작물관리자에 대한 공사시행명령서등) ①영 제9조제1항의 규정에 의한 공사시행명령서는 별지 제11호서식과 같다.
rows.text_en: Article 9 (Order for Execution of Work, etc. for Managers of Other Works) ① The order for execution of work pursuant to the provisions of Article 9, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in the form of Annex No. 11 .

rows.source_ko: ②영 제9조제2항의 규정에 의한 타공작물관리자의 준공검사신청은 별지 제12호서식에 의한다.
rows.text_en: ② The application for completion inspection by a manager of other works pursuant to the provisions of Article 9, Paragraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in accordance with Form No. 12 of the Attached Form .

rows.source_ko: ③영 제9조제3항의 규정에 의한 유지관리명령서는 별지 제13호서식과 같다.
rows.text_en: ③ The maintenance order pursuant to the provisions of Article 9 , Paragraph 3 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in the form of Annex 13 .

rows.source_ko: 제10조(도로대장) 법 제14조의 규정에 의한 도로대장은 별지 제14호서식과 같다.
rows.text_en: Article 10 (Road Register) The road register pursuant to the provisions of Article 14 of the Act shall be in the form of Annex No. 14 .

rows.source_ko: 제11조(제한차량 운행허가 신청서) 영 제10조제3항의 규정에 의한 도로운행 허가신청서는 별지 제15호서식과 같다.
rows.text_en: Article 11 (Application for Permission to Operate Restricted Vehicles) The application for permission for a restricted vehicle to travel on a road pursuant to the provisions of Article 10, Paragraph 3 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in the form of Annex No. 15 .

rows.source_ko: 제12조(점용의 허가신청서등) ①영 제11조제1항의 규정에 의한 도로점용허가신청서는 별지 제16호서식과 같다.
rows.text_en: Article 12 (Application for Permission for Occupancy, etc.) ① The application for permission for road occupancy pursuant to the provisions of Article 11, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in the form of Annex No. 16 .

rows.source_ko: ②영 제11조제2항의 규정에 의한 도로점용허가 내용의 공고는 별지 제17호서식에 의한다.
rows.text_en: ② The public notice of the contents of the road occupancy permit pursuant to the provisions of Article 11, Paragraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in accordance with Form No. 17 of the Attached Form .
③ Deleted <March 25, 1999>

rows.source_ko: 제13조(점용공사의 완료검사 신청서) 영 제11조제7항의 규정에 의한 도로점용공사의 준공검사신청서는 별지 제18호서식과 같다.
rows.text_en: Article 13 (Application for Completion Inspection of Occupancy Work) The application for completion inspection of road occupancy work pursuant to the provisions of Article 11, Paragraph 7 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in the form of Annex No. 18 .

rows.source_ko: 제13조의2(권리ㆍ의무 승계신고) ① 법 제18조의2제2항에 따라 권리ㆍ의무의 승계신고를 하려는 자는 상속일ㆍ양수일 또는 분할ㆍ합병일로부터 3개월 이내에 별지 제17호의2서식의 권리ㆍ의무의 승계신고서(전자문서로 된 신고서를 포함한다)에 다음 각 호의 서류(전자문서를 포함한다)를 첨부하여 군수에게 제출하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 13-2 (Report on Succession of Rights and Obligations) ① Any person who intends to report the succession of rights and obligations pursuant to Article 18-2, Paragraph 2 of the Act shall submit to the County Governor, within three months from the date of inheritance, the date of assignment, or the date of division or merger, a report on the succession of rights and obligations in Form No. 17-2 (including a report in the form of an electronic document) with the following documents (including electronic documents) attached.

rows.source_ko: 1. 권리ㆍ의무의 취득에 관한 허가 관련 내역서
rows.text_en: 1. Details regarding permission for the acquisition of rights and obligations

rows.source_ko: 2. 권리ㆍ의무의 양도에 관한 계약서(양도의 경우에만 해당한다)
rows.text_en: 2. Contract regarding the assignment of rights and obligations (applicable only in the case of assignment)

rows.source_ko: ② 제1항에 따라 신고서를 제출받은 군수는 「전자정부법」 제36조제1항에 따른 행정정보 공동이용을 통하여 다음 각 호의 구분에 따른 정보를 확인하여야 한다. 다만, 신청인이 제2호의 정보에 대한 확인을 동의하지 아니하는 경우에는 상속인의 가족관계기록사항에 관한 증명서를 첨부하도록 하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: ② The County Governor who receives the report pursuant to Paragraph 1 shall verify the information classified according to each of the following subparagraphs through the joint use of administrative information pursuant to Article 36, Paragraph 1 of the Electronic Government Act . However, if the applicant does not consent to the verification of the information under Subparagraph 2, the applicant shall be required to attach a certificate regarding the family relationship records of the heir.

rows.source_ko: 1. 법인의 분할ㆍ합병의 경우: 분할ㆍ합병 후 존속하는 법인이나 분할ㆍ합병으로 설립되는 법인의 법인등기사항 증명서
rows.text_en: 1. In the case of corporate division or merger: Certificate of corporate registration of the surviving corporation after the division or merger or the corporation established by the division or merger
2. In the case of inheritance: Computerized family relationship registration information of the heir

[This Article was newly added on Sep. 21, 2017.]
[Formerly Article 13-2 was moved to Article 13-3 <September 21, 2017>]

rows.source_ko: 제13조의3(공공목적을 수행하는 법인의 비영리사업) 법 제19조의2제1호에서 “공공목적을 수행하기 위하여 설립된 법인으로서 행정안전부령이 정하는 법인”이라 함은 다음 각호의 법인을 말한다. <개정 1999. 3. 25., 2005. 2. 25., 2008. 3. 4., 2008. 6. 20., 2013. 3. 23., 2014. 11. 19., 2017. 7. 26.>
rows.text_en: Article 13-3 (Non-profit Business of Corporations Performing Public Purposes) In Article 19-2, subparagraph 1 of the Act , the term “corporation established to perform public purposes as prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of the Interior and Safety” refers to the corporations listed in each of the following subparagraphs. <Amended Mar. 25, 1999; Feb. 25, 2005; Mar. 4, 2008; Jun. 20, 2008; Mar. 23, 2013; Nov. 19, 2014; Jul. 26, 2017>
1. Korea Expressway Corporation pursuant to the Korea Expressway Corporation Act

rows.source_ko: 2. 「지방공기업법」 제49조의 규정에 의하여 지하철도의 건설을 목적으로 설립된 법인
rows.text_en: 2. A corporation established for the purpose of constructing a subway system pursuant to the provisions of Article 49 of the Local Public Enterprises Act
3. Korea Rail Network Authority pursuant to the Korea Rail Network Authority Act

rows.source_ko: 4. 「민법」 기타 법률에 의하여 설립된 법인으로서 국가 또는 지방자치단체로부터 비영리사업을 위탁받아 수행하는 법인
rows.text_en: 4. A corporation established under the Civil Act or other laws that carries out a non-profit undertaking entrusted by the State or a local government.

[This Article was newly added on July 1, 1994.]
[Moved from Article 13-2; former Article 13-3 moved to Article 13-4 <September 21, 2017>]

rows.source_ko: 제13조의4(점용료 감면) 영 제11조의2제3항제2호의 규정에 의한 재해 기타 특별한 사정의 정도에 따른 점용료의 감면은 다음 각호에 정하는 바에 따른다.
rows.text_en: Article 13-4 (Reduction of Occupancy Fees) The reduction of occupancy fees based on the degree of disaster or other special circumstances pursuant to the provisions of Article 11-2, Paragraph 3 , Subparagraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree shall be as stipulated in each of the following subparagraphs.

rows.source_ko: 1. 점용목적을 완전히 상실한 경우에는 그 이후의 기간은 점용료의 전액을 면제한다.
rows.text_en: 1. If the purpose of occupation is completely lost, the full amount of the occupation fee for the subsequent period shall be waived.

rows.source_ko: 2. 점용목적을 부분적으로 상실한 경우에는 상실한 면적의 비율에 따라 그 이후의 기간은 점용료를 감면한다.
rows.text_en: 2. In the event that the purpose of occupation is partially lost, the occupation fee for the subsequent period shall be reduced in proportion to the lost area.

rows.source_ko: 3. 농작물등의 재배를 위한 점용의 경우 피해의 정도가 50퍼센트이상인 때에는 점용료의 전액을 면제하고, 50퍼센트미만인 때에는 그 비율에 따라 점용료를 감면한다.
rows.text_en: 3. In the case of occupation for the cultivation of crops, etc., if the degree of damage is 50 percent or more, the full amount of the occupation fee shall be waived, and if it is less than 50 percent, the occupation fee shall be reduced in proportion to that amount.

[This Article was newly added on July 1, 1994.]
[Moved from Article 13-3 on September 21, 2017.]

rows.source_ko: 제14조(재결신청서) 영 제14조의 규정에 의한 재결신청서는 별지 제19호서식과 같다.
rows.text_en: Article 14 (Application for Adjudication) The application for adjudication pursuant to the provisions of Article 14 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in the form of Annex No. 19 .
Article 15 Deleted <June 20, 2008>
Article 16 Deleted <December 30, 2016>
ADDENDA <Ministry of Home Affairs Decree No. 562, May 22, 1992>
This rule shall take effect from the date of its promulgation.
ADDENDA <Ministry of Home Affairs Decree No. 620, July 1, 1994>
This rule shall take effect from the date of its promulgation.
ADDENDA <Ministry of Home Affairs Decree No. 640, Jan. 25, 1995>
This rule shall take effect from the date of its promulgation.
ADDENDA <Ministry of Government Administration and Home Affairs Decree No. 40, Mar. 25, 1999>
This rule shall take effect from the date of its promulgation.
ADDENDA <Ministry of Government Administration and Home Affairs Decree No. 170, June 3, 2002>
This rule shall take effect on July 1, 2002.
ADDENDA <Ministry of Government Administration and Home Affairs Decree No. 268, Feb. 25, 2005>
This rule shall take effect from the date of its promulgation.

rows.source_ko: 부      칙 <행정자치부령 제1525호, 2006. 4. 28.> (한국농촌공사 및 농지관리기금법 시행규칙)
rows.text_en: ADDENDA <Ministry of Government Administration and Home Affairs Decree No. 1525, Apr. 28, 2006> (Enforcement Rule of the Korea Rural Community Corporation and Farmland Management Fund Act)
Article 1 (Enforcement Date)  This rule shall enter into force on April 30, 2006.
Article 2 (Amendment of Other Laws)  ① and ② Omitted

rows.source_ko: ③농어촌 도로정비법 시행규칙 일부를 다음과 같이 개정한다.
rows.text_en: ③ The Enforcement Rules of the Rural Road Maintenance Act are partially amended as follows.
In Article 7, Paragraph 2, “Agricultural Infrastructure Corporation” shall be changed to “Korea Rural Corporation”.
④ to ⑦ omitted
Article 3  Omitted

rows.source_ko: 부      칙 <행정안전부령 제1호, 2008. 3. 4.> (행정안전부와 그 소속기관 직제 시행규칙)
rows.text_en: ADDENDA <Ministry of Public Administration and Security Decree No. 1, Mar. 4, 2008> (Enforcement Rules for the Organization of the Ministry of Public Administration and Security and its Affiliated Agencies)

rows.source_ko: 제1조(시행일) 이 규칙은 공포한 날부터 시행한다.
rows.text_en: Article 1 (Enforcement Date)  This Rule shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation.
Articles 2  through 4 omitted

rows.source_ko: 제5조(다른 법령의 개정) ① 부터 ⑩ 까지 생략
rows.text_en: Article 5 (Amendment of Other Laws)  ① through ⑩ Omitted

rows.source_ko: ⑪ 농어촌 도로정비법 시행규칙 일부를 다음과 같이 개정한다.
rows.text_en: ⑪ The Enforcement Rules of the Rural Road Maintenance Act are partially amended as follows.
